OPENCLAW_WORKERS_LEAKING: OpenClaw on Oracle has more Codex app-server workers than agents (the duplicate-worker leak, LIFE-531).
Restart the OpenClaw gateway when no agent run is in progress; see LIFE-531.
ORACLE_NOT_CONFIGURED: The Oracle Cloud card has no configuration.
ORACLE_OFF_CONTRACT: Oracle's stats did not match the contract.
ORACLE_READBACK_MISMATCH: The card did not read back as written.
ORACLE_STALE: Oracle's stats are older than the freshness limit.
ORACLE_UNREACHABLE: The Oracle stats endpoint could not be reached.
ORACLE_WRITE_FAILED: The card could not be written to Notion.
AT_RISK: The Oracle instance reclaim state is AT_RISK.
